1.Nc3 d6 2.f4 e5 3.fxe5.strategy: Takes the challenging pawn and leaves White with a half-open f-file. The exchange costs White the f-pawn's early claim on the centre, so the game turns on whether play along the f-file is worth it.

1.Nc3 d6 2.f4 e5 3.fxe5 Nc6.strategy: Does not recapture on e5 but develops a piece, so the pawn stays with White. After the exchange on d6 and the recapture with the bishop, White is still a pawn up and Black has only a lead in development to show for it.
1.Nc3 d6 2.f4 e5 3.fxe5 Nc6.name: Dunst Opening: Hergert Gambit
